metadata.name: Hook Test
metadata.description: Validates hook lifecycle: checkpoints, inputs, retries, and optional failures.

userOptional.label: Run post-install validation
userOptional.description: Exercises all hook capabilities: OAuth, questions, checkpoints, health checks, and stress testing.

inputs.name: Test OAuth Sign-in
inputs.description: Validates OAuth input collection (uses mock provider in test)

question.question: App display name
question.description: Tests optional text input with a default value.

actions.title: Harness: succeed with checkpoints
actions.description: Runs three checkpoints over ~4s and completes.

actions.title: Harness: always fails
actions.description: Fails at its second checkpoint to exercise structured failure.

actions.title: Harness: requires this app running
actions.description: Visible when hexos-test is installed; runnable only while it is running.

actions.title: Harness: should never be shown
actions.description: Gated on an app that does not exist.

actions.title: Harness: unknown condition type
actions.description: Uses a predicate this platform does not know; must fail closed (hidden).
